working_tree_note: om9-core, om9-scene, om9-archive, om9-exchange and om9-app/src/session/** are clean at audit time; line numbers there are stable.
spec_package: OpenMatrix9_Codex_Spec_v2/ is ABSENT locally; the planning tree and AGENTS.md are the only spec sources.
m00_scope: Only QymCAD code reuse is approved (2026-10-16). NEEDS_USER_M00_DECISION here: (1) persisting new document data (Document.groups, Entity.extensions) adds keys to the .om9 metadata = archive format decision; (2) the BRep envelope needs OCCT (OM9-L2-01-05). 3DM: provenance only READS already-retained import metadata; no 3DM decision is taken.
dependency: OM9-L2-01-08 (typed units/tolerance) per L2.json; implemented by the first loop.
exclusion: No Layers management UI (L2 exclusion). The LAYERS panel position (left column below INFO & SETTINGS) is a UI concern of the concurrent workflow; this module only exposes layer records and rules.
early_slice: M01: EntityId, LayerId, instance ref, per-entity data, visibility/lock, snapshot. M04/M05 FeatureRef and gem/setting metadata attach later through Entity.extensions WITHOUT changing ObjectId/LayerId.
audit_status_note: The per-L3 `status`/`gaps` fields below are the PRE-IMPLEMENTATION audit of 2026-10-16 and are kept as history. The implemented state per L3 is in implementation_record below and in api.md section 7.1; every L3 now has code, a fixture pair and a named runtime test.

implementation_record.verification: cargo test -p om9-core / -p om9-archive / -p om9-scene / -p om9-app (isolated CARGO_TARGET_DIR); logs in implementation/evidence/M01/OM9-L3-01-03-00N/
deviations: ADR-03-5 (owner decision 2026-10-17: KEEP): FeatureId/Feature/Document.features are real typed records instead of FeatureId = HistoryId, including Feature.outputs; ownership split and the M04 recipe link are recorded in api.md 7.2
ADR-03-6: persistence option A applied for groups/features/extensions; Document.tolerance left out because OM9-L2-01-08 is not implemented
implementation_record.blocked: BRep stays Unsupported (OM9-L2-01-05 / OCCT not approved); not counted as implemented
